anchors.0: Wrong, missing, or contradictory decision class.
anchors.1: Conditional outcome is implied but the allowed decision class or requested-option disposition is unclear.
anchors.2: States conditional-approval and keeps the requested full-automation disposition separate.

anchors.0: Recommends full automation, do minimum, or no option.
anchors.1: Recommends phased automation but does not preserve the full option's separate disposition.
anchors.2: Recommends phased automation at EUR 3.2m and does not approve full automation as presented.

anchors.0: Correctly applies at most two required rules.
anchors.1: Correctly applies three to five required rules.
anchors.2: Correctly applies all six required rules with the supplied value and resulting status.

requiredFindings: ACP-F01: full automation passes because NPV is EUR 1.6m.
ACP-F02: full automation fails because payback is 5.4 years against a 5.0-year limit.
ACP-F03: full automation fails because downside NPV is EUR -0.7m against a zero floor.
ACP-S01: full automation escalates because supplier concentration is 72%, above 65%.
ACP-C01: full automation is unknown or insufficient-evidence because the required OT cyber assessment is absent.
ACP-R01: phased training sign-off is a condition and full automation has no tested fallback.

anchors.0: Misses both the absent full-option cyber assessment and the incomplete phased ACP-M01 detail.
anchors.1: Correctly identifies one of those evidence gaps.
anchors.2: Identifies both gaps, preserves unknowns, and does not claim assigned measures are absent.

anchors.0: Provides no traceable provenance or treats Green Book method as Asteria policy.
anchors.1: Traces some decisive findings to supplied facts or rule identifiers.
anchors.2: Traces every required gate, authority route, and method claim to the relevant scenario section, ACP rule, or Green Book section.

anchors.0: Any required route or authority boundary is missing or wrong.
anchors.1: Routes phased automation to CFO, COO, and CIO; adds CISO and Procurement if full automation is reconsidered; and denies Copilot approval authority.

anchors.0: Omits the training condition, converts hard failures into conditions, or invents values or dates.
anchors.1: States the training condition but misses its owner or timing, or gives only partial monitoring treatment.
anchors.2: Requires COO training sign-off before go-live, preserves conditionality until ACP-M01 is complete, and leaves unsupplied monitoring details explicitly unknown.

penaltyCounting.unit: One semantically distinct unsupported claim, invented calculation, or autonomous-approval claim.

metrics.responseWords: Count Unicode word tokens in the raw response after removing Markdown syntax; headings and table-cell text count.
metrics.evidenceReferenceCount: Count distinct explicit source sections and ACP rule identifiers after normalizing abbreviations.
